summary: Iran conducted multiple missile launches from Kermanshah, Hormozgan, West Azerbaijan, and Khuzestan provinces, including an anti-ship cruise missile toward the Strait of Hormuz, while U.S. aircraft operated over Hormozgan. Israel struck Hezbollah's Radwan Force training camp near Ayn al-Tina, Lebanon, and killed four Hamas operatives in central Gaza, including a Nukhba deputy commander involved in the October 7 attacks. Kuwait reported four injuries from Iranian aggression targeting a vital site.
key_points: Iran launched missiles from at least five locations across Kermanshah, Hormozgan, West Azerbaijan, and Khuzestan provinces, with U.S. aircraft hunting launch squads over Kouhestak. (Source: @shin_persian/12957)
An anti-ship cruise missile was fired from Kuhestak toward the Strait of Hormuz, indicating potential maritime threat escalation. (Source: @shin_persian/12951)

Israeli airstrikes hit a Hezbollah Radwan Force training camp near Ayn al-Tina in the Beqaa Valley, 25 km north of the border, destroying dozens of rockets and launchers. (Source: @manniefabian/59591)

Four Hamas operatives were killed in central Gaza, including Yousef al-Aidi, a Nukhba deputy commander who participated in the October 7 raid and hostage handover ceremony. (Source: @manniefabian/59592)
Kuwait confirmed four injuries (one Kuwaiti, two Italians, one Pakistani) from Iranian aggression targeting a vital site, causing shrapnel fall. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10434)
Lebanese daily alerts recorded 119 warnings, led by 54 drone alerts and 29 artillery shelling incidents, concentrated in Nabatieh and South governorates. (Source: @redlinkleb/55282)
Artillery shelling struck Wadi al-Hujeir, Wadi al-Saluqi, Zoutr al-Sharqiyah, and Mayfadoun, while explosions were reported in Qantara. (Source: @redlinkleb/55292)
Israeli warplanes were observed over the Beqaa Valley and southern Lebanon, coinciding with confirmed strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure. (Source: @redlinkleb/55257)

sections.executive_summary: Iran conducted a coordinated series of missile launches from multiple western and southern provinces, including an anti-ship cruise missile toward the Strait of Hormuz, while U.S. naval and air assets hunted launch teams over Hormozgan. Israel simultaneously struck Hezbollah's elite Radwan Force training camp in the Beqaa Valley, destroying dozens of rockets and launchers 25 km north of its border, and eliminated four Hamas operatives in central Gaza, including a senior Nukhba commander linked to the October 7 assault and hostage handover. Kuwait reported casualties from Iranian aggression against a vital installation, marking a rare direct Gulf impact.

U.S. Air Force and Navy aircraft operated over Kouhestak in Hormozgan Province at 0006Z, hunting for missile launch squads with anti-aircraft activity reported. (Source: @shin_persian/12953)

Missile launch from Kuy-e Ramezan in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province at 0800Z, indicating southwestern launch activity. (Source: @shin_persian/12958)
Missile launch from Omidiyeh in Khuzestan Province at 0624Z, adding to multiple launches from the same province. (Source: @shin_persian/12954)

Four Hamas operatives killed in Israeli strikes in central Gaza last week, including three in a single strike on a meeting to advance attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59592)

Yousef al-Aidi identified as deputy commander of a Nukhba Force cell that raided the Sahaf army post on October 7, 2023, and later participated in the handover ceremony for hostages Eli Sharabi, Ohad Ben Ami, and Or Levy. (Source: @manniefabian/59592)
Mustafa Hassan Oweini, a Hamas sniper operative, and Mahmoud Abu Hweishal, an anti-tank missile operative, killed in the same strike as al-Aidi. (Source: @manniefabian/59592)

key_developments: Iran launched missiles from five distinct locations across Kermanshah, Hormozgan, West Azerbaijan, and Khuzestan provinces within a 24-hour period, including an anti-ship cruise missile toward the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @shin_persian/12957)

U.S. Air Force and Navy aircraft conducted hunter-killer operations over Kouhestak, Hormozgan, targeting Iranian missile launch squads with active anti-aircraft engagement reported. (Source: @shin_persian/12953)
Israeli airstrikes destroyed dozens of Hezbollah rockets and launchers at a Radwan Force training camp near Ayn al-Tina, Beqaa Valley, 25 km north of the Israeli border. (Source: @manniefabian/59591)

Four Hamas operatives eliminated in central Gaza, including Nukhba deputy commander Yousef al-Aidi, directly linked to the October 7 Sahaf post raid and subsequent hostage handover ceremony. (Source: @manniefabian/59592)
Kuwait reported four casualties from Iranian aggression against a vital installation, marking a rare direct kinetic impact on a Gulf Cooperation Council state. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10434)

Lebanese alert system recorded 119 warnings in 24 hours, with drone alerts (54) and artillery shelling (29) concentrated in Nabatieh and South governorates, a 9% decrease from previous day. (Source: @redlinkleb/55282)

Multiple artillery shelling incidents struck Wadi al-Hujeir, Wadi al-Saluqi, Zoutr al-Sharqiyah, and Mayfadoun, while explosions hit Qantara and a controlled detonation was scheduled in Tirflsiyeh. (Source: @redlinkleb/55292)
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from multiple provinces, including an anti-ship cruise missile toward the Strait of Hormuz, demonstrate a deliberate show of force and potential coercion capability against maritime traffic. U.S. hunter-killer operations over Hormozgan indicate active suppression of Iranian launch infrastructure, raising the risk of direct confrontation. Israel's precision strikes on Hezbollah's Radwan Force in the Beqaa Valley and Hamas leadership in Gaza reflect a sustained campaign to degrade proxy capabilities despite ceasefire frameworks. The Kuwait incident signals Iranian willingness to target Gulf infrastructure, potentially expanding the conflict zone.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait's official attribution of casualties to 'sinful Iranian aggression' represents a rare public condemnation by a Gulf state, which may prompt GCC security consultations. Lebanon's high-volume alert data indicates persistent Israeli surveillance and strike activity across southern Lebanon and the Beqaa, likely straining Hezbollah's operational security. The absence of Syrian or Iraqi operational reports despite Iranian launches from border provinces suggests containment or reporting gaps. Israel's domestic political maneuvering around Hamas recognition by Ra'am may influence coalition stability but does not alter immediate military posture.
sections.intelligence_notes: The concentration of Iranian launches from Kermanshah, Hormozgan, West Azerbaijan, and Khuzestan suggests a distributed launch architecture designed to complicate targeting. U.S. aircraft over Kouhestak imply real-time intelligence on launch preparations, possibly from overhead persistent surveillance. Hezbollah's Radwan Force training camp in the Beqaa Valley, 25 km from the border, indicates forward positioning of strategic assets despite Israeli air superiority. The identification of specific Hamas operatives by name and role, including participation in the hostage handover, reflects high-grade Israeli human intelligence penetration in Gaza. Kuwait's vital site targeting warrants further analysis to determine if it was energy, port, or military infrastructure.
